admission_type_official_wording: Subject to entry requirements; procedure for assessing the required requirements

admission_routes.notes: Register on ESSE3 for the Master's eligibility check; the programme is not described as limited entry.
EU-equivalent route where legally applicable; foreign qualifications are assessed by the International Student Desk.
2026/27 pre-admission call for non-Italian citizens holding a foreign degree and not resident in Italy, followed by Universitaly visa pre-enrolment.

academic_requirements.summary: A Bachelor-equivalent degree is required. Direct curricular access applies to Italian classes L-18, L-31, L-33, L-35 or L-41. Otherwise, applicants need 60 CFU across mathematical/computer science, physical science, industrial/information engineering, and economics/statistics areas, including at least 18 CFU in the programme's specified SSD list. Personal preparation is additionally assessed when the degree mark is below 88/110 or the degree is more than 10 years old. For the international pre-admission call, the degree must be in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Economics or Computer Science, awarded by 30 June 2026, and CGPA must be at least 80/100.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: A foreign qualification recognised as suitable. Under the 2026/27 international pre-admission call: Bachelor or equivalent in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Economics or Computer Science, awarded by 30 June 2026.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: Mathematical/computer sciences, physical sciences, industrial/information engineering, and economics/statistics.
At least 18 CFU within one or more of these SSDs, included in the 60-CFU total.

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: Regular route: further assessment below 88/110. International pre-admission call: CGPA at least 80/100.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: Curriculum analysis (subjects and grades), followed by an interview if necessary; international pre-admission also evaluates degree/CV relevance and CGPA.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: No overall programme cap was published on the programme page. The international call separately ranks candidates for pre-admission and financial benefits; its annex states a 60/100 pass threshold and publication by 15 May 2026.

selection_components.component: Curriculum and relevance of academic and extra-academic experience

selection_components.notes: Foreign grading scale normalised to 0-10 for scoring.
Only candidates scoring at least 50/70 on curriculum plus CGPA are interviewed.

language_requirements.summary: English at CEFR B2 or above is required. For the international call, a B2 certificate or a previous degree taught in English is accepted.
accepted_language_certificates: Certificates included in the official UNIVR equivalence list
certificate_exemptions: Previous degree programme taught in English (international pre-admission route)
language_requirements.notes: Duolingo is accepted by the international call only for candidates from Iran or Afghanistan.

required_documents.document: Identity document; passport personal-data pages for non-EU applicants
Bachelor degree certificate, or enrolment/expected-completion certificate
required_documents.condition: If holding a two-year Bachelor, also include the Master's degree.

required_documents.document: Academic transcript in English (transcript of records or Diploma Supplement)
required_documents.condition: Include modules/exams and, if possible, ECTS, weighted average and grading range.
Maximum two pages; include study and work experience.
International-call exemption where the prior degree was taught in English.

required_documents.document: Requirements Assessment Request Form / self-certification of completed exams
required_documents.condition: Regular ESSE3 eligibility-check route, especially for graduates from another university.

document_legalisation_translation_rules: The international call requires the academic transcript in English. Final enrolment recognition/legalisation requirements are handled under UNIVR international-student procedures; no programme-specific legalisation rule was located.

entry_exam_or_test.name: Personal-preparation interview / online pre-admission interview
entry_exam_or_test.minimum_score: International call: 60/100 overall; interview offered after at least 50/70 in curriculum plus CGPA
alternatives: No interview in the regular route when curricular requirements are met and neither the under-88/110 nor over-10-years condition applies
entry_exam_or_test.notes: This is not a TOLC/SAT admission exam.

application_fee.notes: International pre-admission fee; deducted from fees owed after enrolment except for scholarship winners.

tuition_amount_basis: First instalment €358 for 2026/27; later instalments are variable and calculated principally using ISEEU/ISEE-equivalent rules. International-call benefits may instead provide a €1,000 flat rate or scholarship-based reduction.

applicant_category_notes: The 31 March deadline applies only to the international pre-admission-call population, not all foreign-degree holders. Foreign-degree holders outside that population should follow the International Student Desk's applicable route.
